rationale: This mutation resolves the -$18.3k cash deficit by extending 2.0x-3.5x Town Shop fulfillment through Day 30, eliminating the land expansion deadlock by acquiring contiguous plots up to an optimal 16-18 ceiling when existing plots are fully utilized, and integrating batched peak monetization (>= 1.15x base) into shed headroom without starving the 10-order engine cap. It enforces strict crop maturation phase gates to eliminate stranded capital, corrects the zero-animal feed reserve bug to liberate early working capital, and mandates cluster harvesting in routine farm execution to eradicate single-item transit waste.
